complaint_text: I activated the Hutch 30-Day Unlimited Data Pack via Hutch SelfCare App, but the package was not credited to my line even though payment was successful.
My Hutch Work & Study 30-Day Bundle shows active status in the system, but mobile internet is completely disconnected.
